_comment: Illustrative sample data for demo.py. Competitor items are invented examples of the KIND of thought leadership these firms publish — none of them are real articles. Client companies (Nordwind, Cantara, Veltena, Brenner) are entirely fictional. All URLs point to example.com.

signals.title: How agentic AI is rewriting the GBS playbook
signals.summary: Argues that autonomous agents shift GBS from labor arbitrage toward outcome-based delivery models. Outlines a maturity path from task automation to end-to-end process ownership and names talent redeployment as the binding constraint.

signals.title: The state of AI agents in the enterprise: adoption outpaces governance
signals.summary: Survey-style piece finding that agent pilots are spreading faster than the control frameworks around them. Recommends pairing every deployment with a defined process owner and audit trail before scaling.

signals.title: From shared services to integrated business services: the next operating model
signals.summary: Positions integrated business services as the successor to function-by-function shared services. Emphasises cross-functional process towers and a single service management layer.

signals.title: GCCs as innovation engines: five moves for the next 24 months
signals.summary: Argues capability centers should take product ownership rather than ticket queues. Five recommended moves include embedding AI engineering pods and rotating global process owners into the center.

signals.title: Agentic AI pilots stall without process redesign, BCG survey finds
signals.summary: Reports that a majority of surveyed agent pilots fail to scale because the surrounding process was left unchanged. Advocates redesigning the end-to-end flow before automating individual steps.

signals.title: Operating model design in the age of autonomous workflows
signals.summary: Framework piece on how autonomous workflows change spans, layers, and the role of middle management in service delivery organisations.

signals.title: Podcast: what CFOs get wrong about shared services
signals.summary: Conversational episode on common misconceptions about SSC economics. Light on new material; mostly restates established cost-to-serve arguments.

signals.title: Deloitte launches agentic AI suite for shared services operations
signals.summary: Product announcement: a packaged set of AI agents for invoice processing, journal preparation, and service desk triage aimed at GBS organisations. Signals a productised competitor offering in core finance operations.

signals.title: GCC location strategy: cost is no longer the deciding factor
signals.summary: Analysis of location decision criteria shifting from labor cost toward talent depth, AI readiness, and regulatory stability. Includes a comparative scorecard approach.

signals.title: Governance frameworks for autonomous agents in regulated functions
signals.summary: Outlines control objectives and audit evidence for agent-executed finance processes. Relevant background for controls-heavy transformation work.

signals.title: EY announces finance transformation alliance targeting GBS clients
signals.summary: Alliance announcement combining a major ERP vendor's platform with EY's GBS advisory practice. A direct go-to-market signal in the finance transformation space.

signals.title: Why finance functions pilot agents faster than they scale them
signals.summary: Thought-leadership piece on the pilot-to-production gap in finance AI. Attributes the gap to data foundations and process standardisation rather than model capability.

signals.title: Benchmarking the modern SSC: throughput, quality, experience
signals.summary: Benchmark methodology update adding employee and customer experience metrics to classic cost and productivity measures for shared service centers.

signals.title: Webinar recap: target operating models for mid-market finance
signals.summary: Summary of a webinar on TOM design for mid-market CFOs. Introductory level; limited strategic signal.

signals.title: PwC embeds AI agents across managed services delivery
signals.summary: Announces agent-augmented delivery across PwC's managed services contracts, with stated productivity gains reinvested into pricing. A structural signal for outsourcing economics.

signals.title: India GCC market update: hiring stabilises after two hot years
signals.summary: Quarterly market note on GCC hiring volumes and attrition. Useful context, limited direct strategic implication.

signals.title: Accenture reports rapid growth in agentic AI bookings for operations
signals.summary: Earnings-adjacent communication highlighting strong bookings for agent-based operations transformation. Confirms competitor traction in AI-led delivery at scale.

signals.title: Reinventing global delivery: composite teams of people and agents
signals.summary: Describes a delivery model where human process experts supervise fleets of task agents. Positions the model as the successor to pyramid-based offshore delivery.

signals.title: Capability centers move up the value chain: from delivery to product
signals.summary: Trend piece on GCCs taking ownership of digital products and platforms rather than executing delegated tasks.

signals.title: Nordwind Industries announces new group CFO effective January
signals.summary: Leadership change at the top of the finance function. The incoming CFO arrives from a company known for a centralised GBS model — a common precursor to operating model review and a natural engagement window.

signals.title: Nordwind to consolidate European back-office functions in Lisbon hub
signals.summary: Announces consolidation of finance and HR back-office activities into a single European hub. Signals an active shared services agenda with likely demand for transition and process design support.

signals.title: Cantara Group launches group-wide ERP consolidation programme
signals.summary: Multi-year programme to consolidate regional ERP instances onto a single platform. Indicates budget committed to finance infrastructure and openness to transformation partners.

signals.title: Cantara Group evaluates captive center for analytics and finance ops
signals.summary: Reported evaluation of a captive capability center covering analytics and finance operations. Early-stage signal; location and scope not yet decided.

signals.title: Veltena Pharma plans shared services expansion into Krakow
signals.summary: Expansion of the existing shared services footprint with a new Krakow site focused on record-to-report and procurement operations. Direct signal of GBS build-out with near-term advisory needs.

signals.title: Veltena Pharma treasury update: refinancing completed
signals.summary: Routine treasury communication on completed refinancing. No transformation angle visible.

signals.title: Brenner Logistics flags cost programme alongside quarterly results
signals.summary: Quarterly results accompanied by a group-wide cost programme announcement. Cost pressure often precedes shared services and automation initiatives; worth monitoring for scope details.
